boot.slowBody.en: This is taking longer than usual. Keep this screen open while your village loads.
boot.slowBody.text: Hii inachukua muda kuliko kawaida. Acha skrini hii wazi wakati kijiji chako kinapakia.

boot.unsupportedBody.en: Update your browser or Android System WebView, then try again. Your saved village stays on this device.
boot.unsupportedBody.text: Sasisha kivinjari chako au Android System WebView, kisha ujaribu tena. Kijiji chako kilichohifadhiwa kinabaki kwenye kifaa hiki.

boot.languageError.en: Your language could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
boot.languageError.text: Lugha yako haikuweza kupakiwa. Angalia muunganisho wako kisha ujaribu tena.

common.unknownError.en: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
common.unknownError.text: Kitendo hakikuweza kukamilika. Tafadhali jaribu tena.

boot.missing.en: This browser is missing: {detail}. Update your phone (iOS 15 or later) or your browser (Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox from 2021 or later), then open Kagemura again.
boot.missing.text: Kivinjari hiki kinakosa: {detail}. Sasisha simu yako (iOS 15 au mpya zaidi) au kivinjari chako (Chrome, Safari, Edge au Firefox cha mwaka 2021 au baadaye), kisha ufungue Kagemura tena.

boot.realSlow.en: Kagemura is taking a long time to load

boot.realSlowBody.en: Nothing has moved for a while. It keeps loading in the background, or you can start again.
boot.realSlowBody.text: Hakuna kilichobadilika kwa muda. Inaendelea kupakia chinichini, au unaweza kuanza upya.

boot.failureBody.en: Check your connection and try again. Your village is saved on this device.
boot.failureBody.text: Angalia muunganisho wako kisha ujaribu tena. Kijiji chako kimehifadhiwa kwenye kifaa hiki.

boot.description.en: Kagemura: Ninja Clans. Build a hidden mountain village, train warriors, and raid rival strongholds.
boot.description.text: Kagemura: Koo za Ninja. Jenga kijiji kilichofichwa milimani, funza wapiganaji, na uvamie ngome za wapinzani.

boot.pwaDescription.en: Lead a ninja clan: build a hidden mountain village, train warriors, and raid rival strongholds with smoke and sabotage.
boot.pwaDescription.text: Ongoza ukoo wa ninja: jenga kijiji kilichofichwa milimani, funza wapiganaji, na uvamie ngome za wapinzani kwa moshi na hujuma.
